correctness.rationale: The Fourier normalization is correct: T_a has zero-mode a/(2π) and nonzero modes 2 sin²(na/2)/(πan²). Absolute summability and the discrete approximation of character tests give the all-finite-configurations criterion. Nonzero-mode domination for positive λ gives |1−w^n|≤C|1−z^n|. On the closure of the subgroup generated by (z,w), this inequality makes the first projection injective, verifying the continuous-character step when z has infinite order. The character has integer winding k, with |k|≥2 by 0<b<a≤π. The geometric sum is strictly smaller than |k| away from 1, but powers approaching 1 force its supremum to be |k|. If z has order Q the zero frequency multiple Q forces w^Q=1 and the other residues give exactly the finite maximum. Summing the sharp nonzero-mode coefficient inequalities gives Λ≤(1−a/(2π))/(1−b/(2π))<1<a/b, so the zero mode is slack. Vandermonde yields strictness and the characters yield uniform density on the irrational branch. For rational a, the alternating vector on the 2Q-grid selects frequencies Q mod 2Q whose coefficients vanish, including for λ=0. At fixed irrational a, only finitely many widths can have Λ≥ε, proving continuity exactly at the zeros and the claimed Thomae law. The two examples obey the parameter restrictions; in the rational example the extremal residue minimizes |cos(πr/Q)|. Terminology at proof line 89: these are removable (spike) discontinuities, not jumps in the usual one-sided-limit sense; the stated theorem correctly says discontinuous. VERIFICATION.md and checks/check_tent.py were inspected; their finite checks cannot certify the infinite claims and were not rerun.

value.rationale: Subtracting a short-range covariance while preserving positivity on arbitrary samples is a naturally constrained operation. The exact admissible scale set and the quantitative cap are usable and not consequences of mere positivity of the two terms. Countable dense admissibility together with a decaying winding-dependent cap and opposite endpoint strictness in the rational and irrational cases gives genuine structural information.
